extracted_claim: A cubemap is 6 textures bound to GL_TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP. Create via glGenTextures + glBindTexture(GL_TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP). Load 6 faces with glTexImage2D targeting GL_TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP_POSITIVE_X through GL_TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP_NEGATIVE_Z. Use samplerCube in fragment shader. Wrap R coordinate for 3D sampling. Set GL_TEXTURE_WRAP_R to GL_CLAMP_TO_EDGE.
implementation_relevance: HSE textures module currently supports only GL_TEXTURE_2D. Cubemap support would enable skyboxes and environment mapping.

extracted_claim: Skybox is rendered as a unit cube with cubemap texture. To render efficiently: draw LAST (not first) so early-z rejects occluded fragments. Set gl_Position = pos.xyww so z always equals 1.0 (max depth). Use GL_LEQUAL depth function. Strip translation from view matrix via glm::mat4(glm::mat3(view)) so skybox doesn't move with camera.
implementation_relevance: HSE has no skybox. This provides the complete algorithm.

extracted_claim: Cubemaps enable reflection (reflect(viewDir, normal) -> sample cubemap) and refraction (refract(viewDir, normal, ratio) -> sample cubemap). Refractive indices: Air=1.00, Water=1.33, Glass=1.52, Diamond=2.42. Dynamic environment maps require rendering scene 6 times per reflective object (expensive).
implementation_relevance: HSE materials module is missing reflection/refraction — these are advanced material properties.

hse_symbol_grounding.notes: HSE materials only have basic color
